7128.problem: Implement the perceptron learning rule with a for loop: iterate over samples `[(x=[1,1],y=1),(x=[0,0],y=0),(x=[1,0],y=0)]`, compute prediction, update weights if wrong. Print final weights.
7128.answer:
local samples = [[[1,1],1],[[0,0],0],[[1,0],0]]
local w7128 = [0.0,0.0]
local bias = 0.0
local lr7128 = 0.1
for (sample in samples) {
  local x = sample[1]
  local y = sample[2]
  local pred = if (w7128[1]*x[1]+w7128[2]*x[2]+bias >= 0.5) 1 else 0
  if (pred != y) {
    local err = y - pred
    w7128[1] = w7128[1] + lr7128*err*x[1]
    w7128[2] = w7128[2] + lr7128*err*x[2]
    bias = bias + lr7128*err
  }
}
println(w7128)
